problem:
Which of the following determinants are equal to $0?$

$$
|A|=|\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3} & 5 & -1 \\ 4 & -3 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|,\,|B|=|\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & -5 & 0 \\ 1 & -\sqrt{3} & 4\end{aligned}|,\,|C|=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 4 & -1 \\ 6 & \sqrt{3} & 3 \\ -4 & \sqrt{7} & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Conditions When a Determinant Equals Zero

feedback.worked_solution:
Let's examine each matrix in turn.

- Since $A$ has proportional rows, we obtain

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 3 \\ -2 & 0 & -2 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\,⟹\,det(A)=0.
$$

- Since $B$ is a triangular matrix, we obtain

$$
|B|=-1\cdot 1\cdot 3=-3
$$

Therefore, $det(A)-2det(B)=0-2\cdot (-3)=6.$
